answer_1.quote: We perform evaluation on a new set of general and culturally-nuanced prompts created independently by native speakers for each language.

answer_2.quote: We also use LLMs to perform a preliminary safety evaluation, for which we do not engage KARYA workers due to ethical concerns.
automatic_metrics: exact match with the Hindi block words from the FLORES Toxicity-200

answer_3.quote: In addition to performing human evaluations, we build upon prior work on LLMs as multilingual evaluators to perform the same evaluations using LLMs as judges.

answer_4.quote: we ask human evaluators employed by KARYA, an ethical data company, to perform two evaluation tasks: comparative evaluations between models, and individual evaluations or direct assessments of 30 models.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are provided with the query, the two model responses (model names are hidden), and set of three options - A (response 1 is better), B (response 2 is better), and C (tie, equally good/bad).
